_purpose: SAWYAN /sawyan-robot Lessons Ledger. Every bug the Founder finds by hand MUST be added here as a CLASS rule (never an element-specific patch) and mapped to the gate that now catches the whole class. If no gate can catch it yet, status = 'uncovered' and it blocks the 'Definition of Done'.

root_cause_classes.RC1_PRESENCE_NOT_BEHAVIOR: Tests verified that elements exist / screens load, but never pressed what a human presses.
root_cause_classes.RC2_PATCH_INSTANCE_NOT_CLASS: Each complaint got one hard-coded assertion for that exact element (e.g. 4 named modals, first bell item) instead of a rule for every element of that kind.
root_cause_classes.RC3_SILENCE_EQUALS_PASS: Visible error text, click-time exceptions and unhandled rejections were not monitored; the robot even closed popups programmatically instead of using their buttons.
root_cause_classes.RC4_HAPPY_PATH_DATA_ONLY: Demo data never triggers business-rule rejections (soft-hold cap, unfunded merchant, spam guard...), so their messages were never seen.
root_cause_classes.RC5_DERIVED_VALUE_IN_MANY_PLACES: The same number (team size, carry-on, qualified count) is computed separately in several JS files instead of one authoritative PostgreSQL field (violates D21).
root_cause_classes.RC6_NO_SPEC_TO_UI_CONTRACT: Constitutional concepts (Carry-On, 4-state reviews, 1Me) have no registry saying which screen must show them.
root_cause_classes.RC7_SELF_CERTIFICATION: The same agent writes the change and declares '100% GREEN' with a robot that cannot see the change; no interaction proof required before publishing.
root_cause_classes.RC8_STALE_CACHE: Manual ?v= cache-bust strings drift; the Founder sometimes tests an old file and sees bugs that were already fixed (or misses new ones).
